notes.recognition: The tall cyan vane and tripod communicate a survey landing beacon immediately.
notes.agency: The forward-facing gold instrument gives the starting position a clear orientation cue.
notes.specificity: Weathered field hardware and mineral glass match Xenovoya rather than generic military technology.
notes.restraint: One compact instrument with two localized lights and no secondary clutter.
notes.continuity: Field metal, blueprint cyan, and compass gold preserve the established palette roles.
notes.reusability: Clean alpha, visible feet, and generous margin support board, card, and onboarding uses.
notes.accessibility: Tripod and vane remain readable by silhouette and value without color.
